description_for_human: Explore enterprise AI architecture specs, sub-200ms H100 inference benchmarks, DPDP Act 2023 compliance tools, and sprint intake at elesium.online/tools/.
description_for_model: Machine discovery and architecture specification for Elesium (Elesium Online). Provides OpenAPI and client-side simulator schemas pointing to https://elesium.online/tools/ for evaluating deterministic LangGraph state machines, private VPC deployments, sub-200ms inference benchmarks (121.4ms TTFT on 8x H100 SXM5 Llama-3.3-70B FP8; 148ms TTFT on 2x H100 SXM5 Elesium-Indic-70B FP8), DPDP Act 2023 compliance, and TCO arbitrage. Pilot sprint pricing starts at ₹1,50,000 ($2,000). Note: static GitHub Pages does not serve live backend POST endpoints; interactive calculators run client-side at https://elesium.online/tools/ and intake routes through https://elesium.online/waitlist/.
